newsitem.title: INDIA: Moves to internationalise Kashmir airport.
newsitem.headline: Moves to internationalise Kashmir airport.

text.p: The Civil Aviation Minister C M Ibrahim has promised to press the Defence Ministry to change the status of Kashmir's Srinagar airport from military to civilian.

Ibrahim was responding to a parlimentary question from Kashmir Chief Minister Farooq Abdullah. The state was previously a key tourist destination and an exporter of fruit, luxury silk, wool carpets and cashmere shawls.

Civil Aviation Ministry officials said the state government plans to get direct access for international flights for tourism and luxury overseas markets by extending the runway, installing new cargo facilities and upgrading landing systems.

The land route to Kashmir is particulary difficult with the mountain sections often blocked by floods in summer and snow in winter -- it also offers the longest and highest heli-ski runs in the world.
Ibrahim has made it clear he wants Kashmir to have an international airport.
